_about: Standing decisions from Corentin. Every agent reads this file and must not raise these as problems. Updated 21 Oct 2026.

intentional_blocks.note: Notting Hill, Bayswater, Marylebone and Woolwich calendars are blocked on purpose. Blocked nights are not demand and not lost revenue: exclude them from opportunity and occupancy-gap findings.

special_setups.P14: Primrose Hill pricing (incl. the £500 minimum) is a deliberate special setup. Do not propose changing its min, base or min-stay; report its numbers only.

booking_visibility_booster: Booking.com Visibility Booster is raised on selected dates on purpose, so commission above 15% on those bookings is expected. Only flag commission that is above 15% AND not explained by the booster (ask before assuming).

length_of_stay_discounts.note: Same discounts on Airbnb and Booking.com (Airbnb screenshot 18 Oct 2026). A stay of 7-27 nights is expected 15% under the nightly price, 28+ nights 20% under. Only the gap beyond that is a leak.

linked_listings.P13: Smoobu 3064856 and 3090701 are ONE Shepherd's Bush flat. Their bookings are combined; nights blocked on one because the other is booked are bookings, not blocks.

property_facts.P05: St John's Wood (Abbey Rd): 4 bedrooms, 5 beds including a sofa bed (Corentin, 18 Oct 2026). PriceLabs shows 4 bedrooms since 19 Oct 2026; benchmark against 4-bed listings.

channel_pricing.booking_markup_note: Smoobu adds +20% to the PriceLabs price on Booking.com (confirmed by Corentin 20 Oct 2026). Expected Booking price = 1.2 x PriceLabs, before stay discounts.
channel_pricing.booking_stacked_promotions: Corentin confirms Booking.com promotions stack on top of each other (20 Oct 2026). A Booking paid rate below 1.2 x price after stay discounts is explained by these promotions: report its size, do not call it unexplained.
channel_pricing.airbnb_discount: Was: manual Airbnb promotions on selected dates giving 15-20% off (Corentin, 21 Oct 2026). All removed 21 Oct 2026. From bookings made after 21 Oct, Airbnb paid-vs-price should be close to PriceLabs minus the 15%/20% stay discounts; flag any remaining gap as unexplained.
channel_pricing.booking_markup_scope: The Smoobu +20% Booking.com markup is global (all apartments); it cannot be set per flat (Corentin, 21 Oct 2026). Per-flat levers are Booking.com promotions (per property) and PriceLabs prices.

airbnb_smoobu_settings_21oct.pricing_rules_listing_B: LOS 5+ nights -10%, 7+ -15%, 28+ -25%; Last-minute -15% within 28 days; Early bird -15% at 60+ days

airbnb_smoobu_settings_21oct.finding: These Smoobu 'Default pricing rules' are pushed to Airbnb and stack on top of PriceLabs prices, which already include PriceLabs' own last-minute and far-out logic. They explain the systematic Airbnb gap (~0.76-0.80x PriceLabs) that removing date promotions did not change.
airbnb_smoobu_settings_21oct.changed_21oct: Both Shepherd's Bush Airbnb listings (Corentin, 21 Oct 2026): last-minute -10% within 14 days, early bird -10% at 60+ days, 7+ nights -15%, 28+ nights -20%, guests included 4, extra guest ~£15. No per-flat Airbnb price adjustment exists in Smoobu (the Airbnb price adjustment is global, 0%).
airbnb_smoobu_settings_21oct.check_after_change: 21 Oct after the change: Airbnb Shepherd's Bush, 31 Oct-2 Nov, 4 guests = £488 total with NO strikethrough (Booking.com flexible £490). The last-minute pricing rule is not shown to guests as a discount; the strikethrough seen earlier (£450 -> £404) came from the manual promotions.

channel_pricing.airbnb_visible_discounts: Corentin prefers discounts that Airbnb shows to guests (strikethrough) over invisible PriceLabs cuts (21 Oct 2026). Propose 'price in' set-ups (Smoobu Airbnb uplift + visible discount) rather than removing visible discounts.

Nights after the date are not inventory: exclude them from occupancy, opportunity and lost-demand findings, and propose nothing for them. Before the date, maximise revenue normally.

airbnb_after_promotions_removed.why: Manual Airbnb promotions (15-20%) removed 21 Oct. Check Airbnb booking volume vs the prior 14 days and paid vs PriceLabs on bookings made after 21 Oct.
airbnb_after_promotions_removed.finding_21oct: Airbnb Shepherd's Bush 3064856, 8-11 Nov, 4 guests: £632 total after the change = £482 room + £150 cleaning vs PriceLabs £633, still ~24% under PriceLabs. The reduction is systematic (~0.76-0.80x on every date checked), so it is not only the date promotions: check Smoobu → Channel Manager → Airbnb price settings. Source found: Smoobu Airbnb default pricing rules (last-minute -15% within 28 days, early bird -12/-15% at 60+ days, 5-night -8/-10%).
